title: LRU cache
description: LruCache(capacity) remembers at most `capacity` entries. get and set both count as "using" a key. When the cache is full, setting a NEW key throws out the least recently used one. Setting a key that already exists never evicts anything. keys() lists the keys from least to most recently used; has and peek do not count as use.
hint: Follow the order of keys() after each call. Who moves to the back, and when is anything evicted?
